integrity: The proof is analytic with supplementary finite checks, not a numerical or externally certified mathematical proof.
scientific_limitations: Known fixed positive relative pool weights and distinct positive per-distance attenuation rates, no extra sources/dilution, one-dimensional stationary unidirectional transport, independent equal-effort Poisson counts; inference is structural/local, not calibrated to observations.
title: Two downstream environmental-DNA counters: identifiable source distance and a universal distant-source sensor gap
